extracted.name: Chef John's Mayo Method Steak Sauce
extracted.description: It's so easy to whip up your own steak sauce from mayonnaise plus a few other things. Vary the basic mayo-based sauce formula to make it your own.
instruction_lines: Combine mayonnaise, anchovy oil, lemon juice, rosemary, and harissa in a bowl. Let stand about 5 minutes to blend flavors before serving.
